training.title: Incompany Training
training.description: We teach teams in any department to build their own AI products. From zero to hero in two weeks, inside your company.
training.heroHeading: What used to wait on IT now starts in <u>your team.</u>
training.heroLead: In two weeks the department ships a live module. AI in the process, human intelligence in command.
training.heroCta: I want this for my team

sectors.label: any sector of the company gains autonomy

queue.label: no queues to launch your products

training.learnHeading: The request stays. Who <u>builds</u> it changes.
training.learnLead: Today a good idea crosses the whole company and waits in line. With the Incompany training, it is born and goes live inside the sector itself.
training.normalTitle: One idea, one queue, one product that arrives late.
normalSteps: Sends it to the team that will build it
That team receives it and opens a ticket
The ticket joins a priority queue
You lose visibility, and the dev team sets the priority
Often, it is no longer needed
training.pivotTitle: That is where Matilha comes in.
training.pivotBody: We cut the queue: the lab moves inside your sector.
training.matilhaTitle: The idea is born and goes live in the sector itself.
matilhaSteps: Applies what it learned in the training
In 2 weeks, the product is live
training.matilhaResultValue: the 1st product. The team keeps building the next ones.
training.pathsClosing: This happens because the team is trained with our <u>Incompany training</u>: skilled and ready to solve endless problems without leaving the department.
training.shiftHeading: Before: one queue. Now each department builds its own module.
training.beforeBody: A request to IT. A marketing queue. A brief that waits. Internal product lived on the other side of the building.
training.afterBody: Each team gains the craft to create. Legal builds its own. Compliance builds its own. Engineering builds its own. The company stops depending on a single queue.
training.whoHeading: From startup to large enterprise: applied AI that drives results.
training.whoLead: A training for teams that want to turn ideas into real solutions, gain speed and apply artificial intelligence with autonomy.
training.whoStartupsBody: Equip your team to validate ideas, build solutions and automate processes with AI from day one. All with more agility and less technical dependence.
training.whoEnterpriseBody: Prepare entire areas and teams to apply AI day to day, build internal solutions and meet business demands with security, autonomy and efficiency.
training.modulesHeading: From the first product to a system that talks to the company.
training.basicBody: Incompany, hands on. The team leaves zero and ships a real internal product: idea, flow, interface and an AI application that solves a live problem in the department.
basicItems: Discovery of the problem in the team's own context
An AI application ready to use
A team ready to build the next module
training.advancedBody: For teams already building who need to go beyond the prototype. Services with databases, name recognition and language intent. The product starts to understand what people ask for and to keep what the company already knows.
advancedItems: Modules that talk to each other
training.method1Body: We go to the team. The lab is the real context, not a generic course.
training.method2Body: Not slides. A live application in the hands of the people who will use it.
training.method3Body: Each department gains the craft to continue alone. Matilha starts it. The team keeps going.
training.timelineHeading: The team arrives without a product. It leaves with one live.
training.timelineLead: An incompany lab, a real problem, a working application at the end. Then teams already building go deeper into language and data.

steps.title: Immersion in the department
steps.body: The real problem, in the real context. Legal, operations, marketing: the lab is the team itself.

steps.title: Designing the module
steps.body: Flow, experience and what the AI will do. The team defines the product it will build.

steps.title: Hands on
steps.body: The application takes shape. Interface, intelligence and a flow that solves the daily demand.

steps.title: Product in their hands
steps.body: Not slides. A live tool, used by the people who asked for it. The team already has the range for the next module.

steps.title: Language and data
steps.body: Teams already building go further: databases, names, entities and language intent. The product starts talking to the company.

training.ctaHeading: Which department in your company is still waiting in line?
training.ctaBody: Tell us the problem. We assemble the right module for your team.
training.ctaFormulaOut: as many products as you need
training.ctaFormulaNote: The capability stays in the department. The next module does not have to cross the building.

common.processHeading: From the first chat to a live product.

process.title: Listen
process.body: We understand the business, the people and the problem before any screen.

process.title: Design
process.body: We turn what we hear into flows, concepts and prototypes you can test.

process.title: Validate
process.body: We put it in front of real users, measure and adjust fast.

process.title: Deliver
process.body: Work ready to scale, with your team involved in every decision.

common.ctaHeading: Shall we talk about your project?
common.ctaBody: Tell us the challenge. We reply within 1 business day.

uxui.intro: A good interface is one nobody needs to explain.
uxui.lead: We design sites, apps and systems around how people actually behave. Every screen has a clear goal, every click moves closer to a business result.

deliverables.title: Research and usability testing
deliverables.body: Interviews, tests and usage data so decisions rest on evidence, not opinion.

deliverables.title: Architecture and flows
deliverables.body: Navigation and journeys organized so people find what they need effortlessly.

deliverables.title: Interface and prototypes
deliverables.body: High fidelity screens and clickable prototypes, ready to validate and build.

deliverables.title: Design system
deliverables.body: Components and rules that keep the product consistent as it grows.

uxui.seoDescription: UI/UX Design at Matilha: research, flows, interfaces and design systems for sites, apps and platforms that convert.

build.label: // FROM SKETCH TO PIXEL
build.heading: An interface is built in layers.

steps.title: Wireframe
steps.body: Structure before style. Where everything lives and what comes first.

steps.title: Hierarchy
steps.body: Type and space guide the eye. In seconds people know what to do.

steps.title: Identity
steps.body: Color, imagery and brand add desire without getting in the way.

steps.title: Interaction
steps.body: Every click responds. Clear feedback turns intent into conversion.

challenge.label: // LIVE TEST
challenge.heading: Find the checkout button.
challenge.lead: Two screens, one task. Start and click the right button as fast as you can.
challenge.resultBody: On the first screen you took {a}s. On the second, {b}s.
challenge.resultEqual: You were fast on both. Now picture someone in a hurry.

serviceDesign.intro: The experience doesn't start on the screen, and it doesn't end there.
serviceDesign.lead: We map the whole journey, from back office to customer care, so every touchpoint works together. The result is a service that makes sense for the people who use it and the people who run it.

deliverables.title: Journey map
deliverables.body: Every customer moment, with pain points, expectations and opportunities in plain sight.

deliverables.title: Service blueprint
deliverables.body: What happens front stage and backstage, with people, systems and processes connected.

deliverables.title: Research with real people
deliverables.body: Customers, teams and partners heard up close to see the service as it really is.

deliverables.title: Rollout plan
deliverables.body: Priorities, pilots and metrics to get the new service off the ground.

serviceDesign.seoDescription: Service Design at Matilha: journeys, blueprints and research for services that work end to end.

daas.intro: A design team inside yours, without the hiring delay.
daas.lead: We embed Matilha designers in your daily routine, at your product's pace. You get seniority, method and speed, with the flexibility to scale the team with demand.

deliverables.title: Dedicated designers
deliverables.body: UI, UX and product professionals integrated into your rituals and tools.

deliverables.title: Tailored squad
deliverables.body: Team setup adjusted to the product's moment, up or down.

deliverables.title: Matilha method included
deliverables.body: Processes, rituals and good practices that stay with your team.

deliverables.title: Ongoing support
deliverables.body: Close management and metrics to ensure quality and delivery.

daas.seoDescription: Design as a Service (DaaS) at Matilha: a dedicated design team embedded in your product, with flexibility.

branding.intro: Before it's seen, a brand needs to be understood.
branding.lead: We create names, identities and languages that tell who you are and where you're going. From strategy to the last visual detail, the brand is born ready to live anywhere.

deliverables.title: Brand strategy
deliverables.body: Purpose, positioning, archetypes and the tone of voice that guides every decision.

deliverables.title: Naming
deliverables.body: Names with concept, sound and availability checks.

deliverables.title: Visual identity
deliverables.body: Logo, colors, typography and graphics forming a recognizable system.

deliverables.title: Brandbook and applications
deliverables.body: A complete guide and applied pieces so the brand reaches the world whole.

branding.seoDescription: Branding and Naming at Matilha: strategy, name, visual identity and brandbook for brands with presence.

build.label: // FROM NAME TO BRAND
build.heading: Every brand starts with a name.

steps.title: Naming
steps.body: Dozens of options, one choice. Concept, sound and availability decide.

steps.title: Symbol
steps.body: A simple sign that works from favicon to billboard.

steps.title: Color and type
steps.body: Palette and typography give the brand its voice and warmth.

steps.title: Applications
steps.body: The brand leaves the page and lives on packaging, screens and streets.

challenge.label: // BRAND RECALL
challenge.heading: Which brands do you remember?
challenge.lead: Eight brands flash by, one at a time. Then mark the ones that stuck.
challenge.resultBody: You remembered {strong} of 2 brands with identity and {generic} of 6 generic names.
challenge.resultFalse: And you marked {count, plural, one {# name that never showed up} other {# names that never showed up}}.
challenge.resultClean: And you fell for no fake names. Great memory!

development.intro: Design that never ships is just a good intention.
development.lead: We take the product from prototype to production with the same team that designed it. Fast, accessible sites, apps and systems ready to grow, with artificial intelligence where it makes a difference.

deliverables.title: Sites and platforms
deliverables.body: Front end and back end with performance, SEO and content management.

deliverables.title: Apps and systems
deliverables.body: Web and mobile products with integrations, dashboards and business rules.

deliverables.title: Applied AI
deliverables.body: Automations and smart features that solve real product problems.

deliverables.title: Continuous evolution
deliverables.body: Monitoring, improvements and new releases after launch.

development.seoDescription: Development and Technology at Matilha: sites, apps, systems and applied AI, from prototype to live product.

build.label: // FROM CODE TO LIVE
build.heading: Good software is software that stays up.

steps.title: Code
steps.body: Clean, typed components written to last and to change without fear.

steps.title: Tests
steps.body: Every change goes through automated tests before it reaches anyone.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.body: From commit to production in minutes, with previews to validate first.

steps.title: Live
steps.body: Real time monitoring, high performance and a team keeping watch.

challenge.label: // LIVE TEST
challenge.heading: Click Buy as fast as you can.
challenge.lead: Two sites, one task. One was rushed, the other was optimized. Feel the difference.
challenge.resultBody: On the slow site you took {a}s. On the optimized one, {b}s.
challenge.resultMisses: And you missed {count, plural, one {# click} other {# clicks}} because the page moved.
challenge.resultFactor: {factor}x faster with a well built site.
challenge.resultEqual: You were fast on both. Your customer on 4G might not be.

mvp.intro: Find out if the idea holds up before betting everything on it.
mvp.lead: We test the business model with real people, prototypes and quick experiments. You choose the next step with data in hand, not guesswork.

deliverables.title: Clear hypotheses
deliverables.body: What has to be true for the business to work, written down and prioritized.

deliverables.title: Prototypes and MVP
deliverables.body: The minimum version that lets you test value with the people who will pay for it.

deliverables.title: Market experiments
deliverables.body: Landing pages, interviews and tests to measure interest and willingness.

deliverables.title: Decision report
deliverables.body: Learnings, numbers and a straight recommendation: go, adjust or stop.

mvp.seoDescription: Business Model Validation at Matilha: hypotheses, prototypes, MVP and experiments to decide with data.
